summary: Website for Shri Balaji Cricket Academy — a cricket coaching academy for children aged 7 and above.
architectural_notes: Static informational website; no backend required initially

existing_features.title: Create a Hero section on the homepage featuring the academy name 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy', a compelling tagline, and a call-to-action button encouraging parents to enroll their children.
Create an 'About Us' section describing the academy's mission, coaching philosophy, and commitment to nurturing young cricket talent.
Create a 'Coaching Programs' section that highlights the available programs, clearly stating the minimum age requirement of 7 years for enrollment, along with program benefits and features.
Create a Gallery section displaying a grid of cricket academy activity images (use generated placeholder images) to showcase training sessions, matches, and academy life.
Create a Contact/Enquiry section with a form allowing parents to submit their child's name, parent's name, phone number, child's age, and a message. Store submitted enquiries in the backend.
Create a sticky navigation bar with links to all page sections (Home, About, Programs, Gallery, Contact) and the academy logo/name. Navigation should be smooth-scrolling.

Apply a bold cricket-themed visual design with a deep green and gold color palette, strong serif/display typography for headings, and a clean, energetic layout evoking a professional sports academy. Enforce this theme consistently across all sections.

Display the full academy address — 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' — in the Contact section's contact info sidebar, alongside the existing phone/email details.
Display the full academy address — 'Shri Balaji Cricket Academy, Malerna Gaon, Ballabgarh, Faridabad 121004' — in the site Footer's contact details area.
